angle: WR/TE break mechanics from Combine route drills (decel into break, speed through break, re-acceleration; combined as Break G) matched to the same NFL route family (SLANT/OUT/HITCH/IN/CORNER) and tested against separation over expected, as a three-link chain plus a pre-set equivalence bound
metric_name: Break G: mean acceleration magnitude (g) over the 1.0 s centred on the sharpest point of a route break, standardized within drill x Combine year, averaged over route drills and shrunk by drill count; same code on NFL snaps
headline_number: Season separation over expected: -0.6 in per sd of Break G (90% CI -2.6 to +1.2, n=116, beyond log pick/40/weight/NGS/TE); equivalence vs +-3 in margin p=0.019; drill trait holds (split-half rho 0.28 [0.16, 0.40], n=145) but does not carry to the same NFL route (rho -0.11 [-0.25, 0.05] vs reliability ceiling 0.46) and harder NFL cuts do not buy separation on the snap (within-player rho 0.01 [-0.05, 0.06], 943 snaps)
what_changed_from_previous: Rebuilt the round-8 WR/TE Break G candidate (7.74, three fatal flaws) around its flaws instead of the TPRR claim. (1) One outcome fixed before the test, as the angle asks: season NGS separation adjusted for cushion/alignment/TE/season (year-to-year r 0.44), plus a pre-set +-3 in equivalence margin, so the result is a bounded null (upper bound +1.2 in per sd), not a fragile positive; TPRR is dropped entirely. (2) Mechanism tested as an explicit three-link chain (drill trait -> same route family in games -> snap SOE), with game-side reliability and the implied ceiling (0.46) so the drill-to-game null is interpretable. (3) One all-tests table with n, 90% intervals, the null each p tests, the family-wise p over four break measures (0.94) and the held-out-class gain (1.3% [-0.9, 3.6]). (4) Action section up top: do not move WRs on route-drill break grades, grade breaks on tape, and a protocol ask (route drills vs a scripted defender, two reps per route). (5) New tracking-native hero (2 rows, paths coloured by g plus accel traces on a shared axis, >=11 pt text) and a forest plot comparing break measures with the official 40, 3-cone, shuttle and weight. (6) Named six-player card chosen by rule with a read per player, including misses. 3 figures + 2 tables, 1,752 words by check.py (about 1,924 by wc).
open_risks: Football usability: the headline is a negative result; judges may score 'usable' lower even though the action (do not buy suddenness scores, protocol change) is concrete
Not a blind test: an earlier round had already seen a null between Break G and snap-level separation; disclosed in limitations
The +-3 in equivalence margin is about half a true sd of season SOE; it can rule out effects as large as weight's, not 1-inch effects (MDE 3.2 in)
Season SOE adjusts for cushion and alignment but not coverage or quarterback; 2025 has one season
Reference measures (40, shuttle, weight) are shown beyond pick and position only; the shuttle's sign (faster = less separation, n=45) is odd and unexplained
Game break force is only weakly repeatable (odd/even 0.23) in a 40-play sample with no defenders, which caps every drill-to-game correlation
